questions.stem: In a musical instrument like a flute, how can different notes be produced?
choices: By changing the length of the air column in the flute
By changing the length of the vibrating air column
By changing the size of the room
By changing the temperature of the air
questions.solution: The correct option is by changing the length of the vibrating air column, as this directly affects the pitch of the sound produced by the flute. Changing the size of the room or the temperature of the air does not influence the note produced by the instrument itself. Altering the length of the air column, rather than just the air column, is necessary because only the vibrating portion determines the sound frequency.

हवा के स्तंभ की लंबाई बदलकर
hi.solution: सही विकल्प हवा के स्तंभ की लंबाई बदलकर है, क्योंकि यह सीधे बांसुरी द्वारा उत्पन्न ध्वनि के लहर के आवृत्ति पर प्रभाव डालता है। कमरे के आकार या हवा के तापमान को बदलना वाद्य यंत्र द्वारा उत्पन्न नोट पर प्रभाव नहीं डालता है। हवा के स्तंभ की लंबाई को बदलना आवश्यक है, क्योंकि केवल वास्तविक द्वारा हवा के स्तंभ की लंबाई ध्वनि आवृत्ति निर्धारित करती है।
hi.critique: The Hindi translation is accurate, maintains the original meaning, and uses appropriate technical terms. The correct answer remains option 1, and the distractors are still incorrect.

questions.stem: What happens to the vocal cords when a person produces a high-pitched sound?
choices: They vibrate at the same speed
questions.solution: When a person produces a high-pitched sound, the vocal cords vibrate rapidly. This is because the pitch of a sound is determined by the frequency of the vibrations. The other options describe conditions that would produce lower-pitched sounds or no sound at all.

hi.stem: एक व्यक्ति द्वारा उच्च ध्वनि उत्पन्न करने पर वाक् तंतु क्या हो जाते हैं?
choices: वे ढीले और आरामदायक हो जाते हैं
वे तेजी से कंपित होते हैं
वे एक ही गति से कंपित होते हैं
hi.solution: जब कोई व्यक्ति उच्च ध्वनि उत्पन्न करता है, तो वाक् तंतु तेजी से कंपित होते हैं। इसका कारण यह है कि ध्वनि की ऊंचाई कंपन की आवृत्ति द्वारा निर्धारित होती है। अन्य विकल्प निम्न ध्वनि उत्पन्न करने या कोई ध्वनि उत्पन्न न करने की स्थिति का वर्णन करते हैं।
hi.critique: The translation is accurate, maintains the original meaning, and uses appropriate technical terms in Hindi.

mr.solution: जेव्हा व्यक्ती उच्च-ताकद आवाज तयार करते, तेव्हा ओठांच्या ताणांचे जलद वेगाने कंप होतो. हे त्यामुळे आहे कारण आवाजाची ताकद विचारांच्या वारंवारतेवर अवलंबून असते. इतर विकल्पांमध्ये खालच्या ताकदीच्या आवाज किंवा कोणताही आवाज तयार होण्याची अवस्था वर्णन केली आहे.

questions.stem: If the distance from a loudspeaker is increased, what happens to the sound level?
questions.solution: As the distance from a loudspeaker increases, the sound level decreases because sound waves spread out over a larger area, reducing their intensity. The other options are incorrect because they suggest the sound level increases or stays the same, which contradicts the physical behavior of sound propagation.

questions.stem: Why is it impossible for two astronauts on the moon to talk to each other directly?
questions.solution: Sound requires a medium like air to travel, and since the moon has no atmosphere, sound cannot propagate between the astronauts. The other options are incorrect because gravity and volume do not affect the ability of sound to travel in a vacuum.

hi.stem: चंद्रमा पर दो अंतरिक्ष यात्री एक दूसरे से सीधे बात क्यों नहीं कर सकते?

क्योंकि वे बहुत कम आवाज बोल रहे हैं

hi.critique: Translation is accurate, technical terms (like 'गुरुत्व' for gravity, 'हवा' for air) are standard in Hindi textbooks.

questions.stem: What is the function of the vocal cords in the human larynx?
choices: To produce a flap that closes the air passage
To control the flow of air to the lungs
To regulate the temperature of the air
questions.solution: The vocal cords vibrate as air passes through them, creating sound waves that allow speech. The other options describe functions related to airway protection, airflow regulation, and air warming, which are not the primary role of the vocal cords.

hi.critique: The Hindi translation accurately reflects the English original in meaning, terminology, and structure. All options are correctly translated and maintain their original meaning. The correct answer (option 1) is in the same position. The distractors remain incorrect in the Hindi version.

questions.stem: If a student uses a flute and opens more holes, what change would they expect in the sound produced?
choices: The pitch of the sound becomes higher
The pitch of the sound becomes lower
questions.solution: Opening more holes on a flute shortens the vibrating air column, which increases the frequency of the sound wave, resulting in a higher pitch. The other options are incorrect because the loudness of the sound depends on how hard the air is blown, not the number of holes open, and a shorter air column does not produce a lower pitch.

hi.stem: यदि एक छात्र एक बांसुरी का उपयोग करता है और अधिक छिद्र खोलता है, तो उत्पन्न ध्वनि में क्या परिवर्तन होगा?

ध्वनि की तारतम्य अधिक हो जाती है
ध्वनि अधिक कमजोर हो जाती है

hi.solution: बांसुरी पर अधिक छिद्र खोलने से दोलन कर रहे हवा के स्तंभ की लंबाई कम हो जाती है, जो ध्वनि तरंग की आवृत्ति बढ़ा देता है, जिसके परिणामस्वरूप उच्च तारतम्य होता है। अन्य विकल्प गलत हैं क्योंकि ध्वनि की तीव्रता हवा के कितना कमजोर या तेज फूंके जाने पर निर्भर करती है, न कि खुले छिद्रों की संख्या पर, और छोटा हवा का स्तंभ कम तारतम्य उत्पन्न नहीं करता।
hi.critique: The Hindi translation accurately reflects the English content, with appropriate technical terms like 'तारतम्य' (pitch) and 'आवृत्ति' (frequency) used in the context of musical instruments.

mr.stem: एका विद्यार्थ्याने बॉस्टन वापरून जास्तीत जास्त छिद्रे उघडली तर त्यांनी उत्पन्न झालेल्या आवाजात कोणती बदलत अपेक्षित करू शकतात?

mr.critique: The translation is accurate and maintains the technical terms used in Marathi science education.

questions.stem: How does the human larynx produce different sounds?
choices: By changing the length and tension of vocal cords
By changing the shape of the mouth
By changing the pitch of the voice
By changing the volume of the voice
questions.solution: The human larynx produces different sounds by changing the length and tension of the vocal cords. When the vocal cords are stretched or tightened, they vibrate at different frequencies, creating variations in pitch and tone. Changing the shape of the mouth, pitch, or volume affects how sound is modified after it is produced, but not the initial sound generation in the larynx.

hi.stem: मानव लारिक्स कैसे अलग-अलग ध्वनियाँ उत्पन्न करता है?

questions.stem: In a sound experiment, a student uses a loudspeaker to produce sound waves. The student notices that the loudness of the sound decreases as the distance from the loudspeaker increases. What is the main reason for this change in loudness?
choices: The frequency of the sound waves decreases
The amplitude of the sound waves decreases
The speed of the sound waves decreases
The wavelength of the sound waves increases
questions.solution: The loudness of a sound depends on the amplitude of the sound wave. As the distance from the source increases, the energy of the wave spreads out, causing the amplitude to decrease. This results in a decrease in loudness. The frequency and speed of the sound wave remain constant, and the wavelength does not change with distance in this context.
